test_title: PYST 10: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A sum of ₹ 12,000 is invested at a simple interest rate of 8% per annum. After how many years will the interest amount be ₹ 3,840?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Interest** for 1 year = 8% of 12,000 = 960

Required **Time** = Total Interest ÷ Interest per year

Required **Time** = 3,840 ÷ 960 = 4 years

**∴ The correct answer is 4 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹ 12,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 8% per annum

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹ 3,840

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/799894409e2b4c06ce2bbc014e419aabeaea15330e1997e6948fd0e66f117094.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3,840 = (12,000 × 8 × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 3,840 = 120 × 8 × T

⇒ 3,840 = 960 × T

⇒ T = 3,840 ÷ 960

⇒ T = 4 years

**∴ The correct answer is 4 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

In **Simple Interest**, the interest is calculated only on the initial principal. In **Compound Interest**, interest is calculated on the principal plus the accumulated interest of previous periods.

Amount Formula

The total **Amount (A)** at the end of the period is the sum of the Principal and the Interest: A = P + SI.

Rate and Time Units

Always ensure that the **Rate (R)** and **Time (T)** are in the same time units (e.g., both per annum and years).
